note: Plan 89-05 (ORC-02) adds 24 entries for the PostgreSQL-gated tests of tests/test_89_05_inbox_round_trip.py -- 12 test names x darwin + win32: 8 for the blackboard-inbox round trip on both backends and 4 for migration 032 against a real server -- and removes the 26 entries plan 89-09 put in this shard for the eight tests/test_a2a_*.py files, which this plan deletes with the feature. All carry reason_class pg-no-disposable-database; the 24 are closed by task 89-07-04, the 26 by this plan's own deletion. | Plan 89-07 (task 89-07-04) closed the entries this plan had added: the macOS and Windows cells now have a disposable PostgreSQL, so they excuse nothing on any cell. The entries themselves are listed, test by test, in plan 89-07 record under "## Foreign shards opened".
